title: Cliff Escape Run
description: Leap across crumbling canyon cliffs and narrow stone ledges—one crisp tap turns corners and jumps chasms in high-stakes endless running.
controls: Tap at exact corners and gaps to turn or leap safely along the winding cliff path.

zh-CN.title: 峭壁极限逃亡
zh-CN.description: 极简魔性一指跑酷峭壁极限逃亡：在悬崖峭壁窄道间极速疾驰，看准拐角精准点击转向跳跃绝不掉崖！
zh-CN.controls: 在窄道转角和断崖瞬间精准点击转向跳跃，挑战极限奔跑距离。
